instructions.purpose: Forget one or more conversation facts after resolving them with search-memory.

tool.name: forget-memory
tool.description: Marks resolved live facts as forgotten for the current chat.

usage_rules.rule: Always call search-memory first and pass only exact fact IDs returned by that search.
If the search results do not make every intended fact clear, do not call this tool. Return the ambiguity to Main so Main can ask the user to clarify.
For an explicit, unambiguous forget request, call this tool immediately without asking for confirmation.
Include all clearly matched facts in one call using a non-empty list of unique positive fact IDs.
Never promise that a forgotten fact can be restored.

example.context: search-memory clearly returned fact IDs 12 and 18 for two bicycle details the user explicitly asked to forget.
